hypothesis: Maintain the radius8/max32 future coverage while discounting its contribution relative to immediate free-robot assignment. Smaller forecast population caps lost or tied; this changes objective weight rather than coverage.
design: Selected RANDOM-01 planner seeds4/0 at weights1/0/.25/.5, plus general RANDOM-01 forecast off and radius8 at weights.25/.5/1. Twelve full600-step cases. All other selected/general settings frozen. R05_MATCH_SKIP_ZERO remains0 to isolate this algorithmic comparison from the separately qualified runtime optimization.
validation: Strict1000ms entries,30000ms prep,32decimalGB,16boundphysical/32SMT workers; independent complete replay and source/input/resource/waiting checks. Four declared complete-trace controls:745/740 selected,727 general-off,726 general-weight1. Preserve failures.
qualification: Development comparison on previously used archived input/planner seeds. Exact repeat and paired qualification required for new maxima. No fresh/heldout task/start input or unseen geometry used.
trick: Selected profiles retain explicit --trick RANDOM-01 horizon settings. General profiles retain horizon0 and guidance none; the forecast-weight mechanism itself has no map or horizon dependency.
